verdict.rationale: DPMA offers online databases (DEPATISnet, DPMAregister) and e-filing tools, so a versioned API with a deprecation policy is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only web portals, downloadable filing software and paper/fax routes. Nothing describes a versioned API, API versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the robots.txt probe says nothing about API lifecycle.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
